prime.headline: Chipmakers race to ship 2nm processors in volume
prime.summary: Chipmakers race to ship 2nm processors in volume is drawing attention across the industry. Analysts say the next few weeks will show whether the shift holds.
prime.script: Good evening. Our top story tonight: chipmakers are racing to ship two nanometer processors in volume. The whole industry is watching to see who delivers at scale, and who gets left behind. Analysts say the next few weeks will show whether the shift holds. We will bring you more as it develops. Stay with us.

prime.headline: Satellite broadband reaches remote schools in pilot
prime.summary: Satellite broadband reaches remote schools in pilot is drawing attention across the industry. Analysts say the next few weeks will show whether the shift holds.
prime.script: Okay, you're going to like this one. A pilot program is beaming satellite broadband into remote schools, places where getting online has always been the hard part. A classroom that was cut off is suddenly connected, with no miles of cable to lay. Which means the next generation might never know the pain of a buffering wheel. Now, it's still just a pilot. Analysts say the next few weeks will show whether it really holds up. So we'll keep watching, and tell you the moment we know.

prime.script: Okay okay okay, big day for quantum! Error correction just passed a key lab milestone. Fewer mistakes, from machines that are famous for getting upset. These things are so delicate, they glitch if you look at them funny. It's a lab result, not a product though. Analysts say the next few weeks will show if it holds. We'll keep watching. Stay curious!
